snippet.title: HOSHiN ENGi Re:surrection - 1st Trailer
snippet.description:
The HOSHiN ENGi 30th anniversary project begins.
A roguelite action game starring a new hero drawn by Ryu Fujisaki.
HOSHiN ENGi Re:surrection arrives in 2027.

Wishlist now
PlayStation™Store: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018944/
Steam®: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4474280/_/

■About the game
An all-new roguelite hack-and-slash from Shueisha Games, set in a fantasy world of immortals, demons, and mythic beasts drawn from ancient Chinese mythology. As a young disciple of the legendary sage Taikobo, you're thrown into a land plunged once more into turmoil.

That world comes from HOSHiN ENGi, the Chinese-mythology fantasy by Ryu Fujisaki serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump, now past 22 million copies in print. Thirty years on, Fujisaki has drawn a new hero for an original story set after the manga's ending. Longtime readers will recognize the world. Newcomers can start right here.

Combine a vast arsenal of Paope, the mythic treasures wielded by the gods and immortals of legend, to forge a fighting style all your own, and battle through shifting dungeons with your Reiju at your side. Every run is different; every build is your own! Create powerful synergies, grow stronger with each attempt, and lose yourself in combat that's fast, yet deep, and endlessly replayable.

Fujisaki oversees the project personally, and the hand-drawn visuals look like his pages set in motion.

■Game details
Developer: LASTWONDER
Publisher: SHUEISHA GAMES
Genre: Roguelite Action
Number of players: Single-player
Rating: ESRB 10+
Release date: 2027
Platform: Nintendo Switch™2 / PlayStation®5 / Steam®
Language: English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese

Official Website: https://shueisha-games.com/en/games/hoshinengi/
Official X: https://x.com/SHUEISHA_GAMES

©Tsutomu Ano,Ryu Fujisaki/SHUEISHA
©SHUEISHA, SHUEISHA GAMES developed by LASTWONDER
